title: India vs Sri Lanka: Who Wins the Women's T20 Asia Cup Final?
summary:
Get ready for a cricket showdown! On Sunday, India and Sri Lanka face off in the Women's T20 Asia Cup final in Dubai. Both teams have won every match they've played in this tournament. Only one can take home the trophy.

India is the big favorite. They've won this cup seven times — more than anyone else. Their opening batters, Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana, are the top two scorers in the tournament. Shafali has 168 runs, including two scores of 64. Mandhana smashed an amazing 124 runs against Hong Kong. And bowler Deepti Sharma has taken 11 wickets — the most in the competition.

But don't count out Sri Lanka! They are the defending champions. Two years ago, they beat India in the final by eight wickets. Their captain, Chamari Athapaththu, is their star. She also has 11 wickets, tied with Deepti for the most. She leads by example with both bat and ball.

How did they get here? India beat Bangladesh by 40 runs in the semifinal on Thursday. Sri Lanka beat Pakistan by four wickets in a close, low-scoring game on Friday.

History favors India: they've won nine of their last 10 T20 matches against Sri Lanka. But finals are unpredictable. The match starts at 6:30 p.m. local time in Dubai. Who will lift the trophy? We'll find out Sunday!
why_it_matters: It shows how girls' and women's sports are getting big audiences and big moments — and how a team's weeks of practice and teamwork come down to one match.

keywords.explanation: The team that won the competition last time and is trying to win it again.
In cricket, getting a batter out is called taking a wicket, and a team has ten wickets in its turn at batting.
The match played just before the final, which decides who gets into the final.

background_read: T20 cricket (short for Twenty20) is a fast version of the game where each team bats for 20 overs, so a whole match takes only a few hours.
The Women's T20 Asia Cup is a tournament between the best women's teams in Asia, and this final is being played in Dubai (a city in the United Arab Emirates, a country in the Middle East).

Cricket is one of the most popular sports in South Asia, and matches between India and Sri Lanka are followed by millions of fans. Sri Lanka's captain, Chamari Athapaththu, is one of the few players who is a star with both the bat and the ball.
Article_Structure: WHO: India's team, with batters Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana and bowler Deepti Sharma, against Sri Lanka's team, captained by Chamari Athapaththu.
WHAT: The final of the Women's T20 Asia Cup, with both teams unbeaten so far in the tournament.
WHERE: Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates.
WHY: India is the favourite with seven titles, but Sri Lanka are the defending champions and beat India in the final two years ago, so the result is hard to predict.

perspectives.description: They feel confident, pointing to India's seven titles, their top scorers and their 9-out-of-10 record against Sri Lanka in recent matches.
They say none of that matters in a final, and remind everyone that Sri Lanka beat India to win the trophy two years ago.
They note both teams have won every match so far and that finals are often tense and unpredictable, so either side could lift the trophy.
